{{Top|leg}}
The '''Spacer's Information Manual''', or '''SIM''', was a 5,947-datapage document published by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Bureau of Regulations]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Space Ministry]]. [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]] could purchase it for a nominal fee when they updated or renewed their flight certifications.
